description:
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to build technology solutions that help public health programs operate more effectively. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working directly with users, understanding complex operational problems, and turning them into reliable software that delivers measurable value.

 As an embedded member of a cross-functional team, you will partner with program staff, technical assistance providers, product teams, engineers, and client stakeholders. You will help uncover needs, shape solutions, build and test them with users, and take successful capabilities into production. The role combines full-stack software engineering, workflow automation, data integration, and applied AI in an environment where requirements evolve as teams learn.

 You will be successful if you are equally comfortable writing production code, talking with users, working through ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical decisions.

 Responsibilities
 Discover and define: Work directly with program teams, client stakeholders, and end users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for technology, and translate loosely defined problems into practical technical solutions.
 Prototype and build: Design and build across the full stack, including user experiences, application services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Move quickly from problem definition to working prototypes and iterate with real user feedback.
 Apply AI where it adds value: Build AI-assisted capabilities such as summarization, structured extraction, classification, and workflow support. Preserve appropriate human review and account for reliability, privacy, data governance, and responsible use.
 Deploy and improve: Move successful capabilities into reliable production environments with maintainability, security, error handling, traceability, testing, and operational support in mind. Observe usage, diagnose issues, and improve solutions based on feedback.
 Scale what works: Turn lessons from program-specific implementations into reusable platform capabilities, technical patterns, and components. Surface gaps between platform capabilities and real-world needs and feed those insights back to product and engineering teams.
 Communicate clearly: Explain technical options, feasibility, tradeoffs, and constraints to technical and non-technical audiences. Support demonstrations, walkthroughs, and hands-on sessions with users and stakeholders.

 Qualifications
 Required 
 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful full-stack development experience.
 
 Additional Qualifications 
 Strong programming skills and experience building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable technologies.
 Experience with relational databases, APIs, external services, and production software delivery.
 Ability to work directly with users and stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
 Demonstrated ability to deliver iteratively when requirements are incomplete or changing.
 Experience with version control, code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices.
 
 Preferred 
 Client-facing, embedded, consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
 Experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications, including summarization, structured extraction, classification, evaluation, or AI-enabled workflows.
 Experience building multi-step workflows, stateful applications, or human-in-the-loop processes.
 Experience with case management, workflow, grant management, or program management systems.
 Cloud-native development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, or production operations experience.
 Experience with government technology environments, sensitive data, data governance, privacy, or responsible AI.
 Interest or experience in health, public health, rural health, or public-sector program delivery.
 Professional use of AI-assisted software engineering tools.
 
 How You’ll Work and What Success Looks Like
 This role sits at the intersection of engineering, users, and real-world operations. You will not simply receive a backlog of fully defined requirements. You will work with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to accomplish, determine the right technical approach, and move from idea to working software. Some problems will require traditional engineering; others may benefit from workflow automation, data integration, or AI.

 In your first six months, success means developing a strong understanding of the program and its users, building trusted working relationships, and delivering production capabilities that address meaningful operational needs. Over your first year, you will help turn lessons from individual implementations into reusable capabilities and engineering patterns that make future delivery faster and more consistent.

 Technology environment: JavaScript/TypeScript-based front-end development, server-side application development, relational databases, RESTful APIs, cloud services, workflow and state management, LLM-enabled application patterns, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more than matching every tool in the stack.
 
 
 Working at ICF 
ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.
 We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our  EEO  policy.

 We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 Work Authorization and Sponsorship 
 All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.
  
 Reasonable Accommodations 
 Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  Candidateaccommodation@icf.com  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.  

 Read more about  workplace discrimination rights  or our benefit offerings which are included in the  Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.  

 Bot and Third-Party Applications 
 Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration.  Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration .   Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact  Candidateaccommodation@icf.com  for assistance.
  
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.  

 However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at  candidateaccommodation@icf.com . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  

 Pay Range 
 There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. 

 The pay range for this position based on full-time employment is:
$98,614.00 - $167,644.00 
 
Nationwide Remote Office (US99)
